description: This file defines functions related to failover policy decision-making in a system, specifically determining whether certain cooldown probes should be allowed, used transiently, or preserved based on the failover reason.

methods.name: export function shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason( shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason
methods.description: Decides if a cooldown probe is allowed based on the failover reason.

methods.name: export function shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Determines if a transient cooldown probe slot should be used based on the reason.

methods.name: export function shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Checks if the transient cooldown probe slot should be preserved for certain reasons.
